regcmp.note: regcmp of libPW in /bin/regcmp (and the same code in /usr/bin/acctcom at 0x172e): open, a compiler form (2026-11-24, increment 161 'regcmp'). Two places compile a condition with || or && through a temporary of the compiler: `if ((c=='*') || (c=='+') || (c=='{'))` (cp r12,#'*'; ldk r2,#0; tcc eq,r2; ld @r15,r2; test r2; jr ne; the same for '+' with test @r15; '{' a plain jump) and `while (((c = *sp++) != '}') && (c != ','))` (tcc ne into 2(r15), the inc of sp behind the store). The two words lie below the parameter homes (~L1 := 4: ldm 4(r15),r2,#6), so they are no variables of the source; with ccv1 the frame is 4 bytes smaller, all offsets 4 lower; masked, about 24 lines of real code differ. No compiler of the tree (ccv0 .. ccv1r, cc, with and without -O) makes it; about 40 source forms tried (?:, |, &, sums, != 0, de Morgan, flag variables, flag arrays: best 30 lines, the flags then lie above the parameter homes).
